info.title: AgentMail API
info.description: REST API for AgentMail — inboxes, messages, threads, drafts, domains, pods, API keys, webhooks, and metrics.

delete.description:

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages delete --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-id <message_id>
```

post.description:
Create a new agent organization with an inbox and API key. This endpoint is for signing up for the first time. If you've already signed up, you're all set — just use your existing API key.

A 6-digit OTP is sent to the human's email for verification.

This endpoint is idempotent. Calling it again with the same `human_email` will rotate the API key and resend the OTP if expired.

The returned API key has limited permissions until the organization is verified via the verify endpoint.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail agent sign-up --human-email user@example.com --username my-agent
```

Verify an agent organization using the 6-digit OTP sent to the human's email during sign-up.

On success, the organization is upgraded from `agent_unverified` to `agent_verified`, the send allowlist is removed, and free plan entitlements are applied.

The OTP expires after 24 hours and allows a maximum of 10 attempts. If you run into any difficulties receiving the OTP code, you can also create an account on [console.agentmail.to](https://console.agentmail.to) using the human email address you provided to verify your account.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail agent verify --otp-code 123456
```

get.description:
Searches inboxes in the organization by address or display name, ranked
by relevance. Each word in the query matches the start of a word in the
address or display name, so `sup` matches `support@example.com` but
`port` does not. An exact address match always ranks first. `limit`
cannot exceed 100. A page can be empty and still carry a
`next_page_token`; keep paging until the token is absent.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Address or display name to search for. Matches word prefixes. Must be 2 to 256 characters.

get.description:
Full-text search across threads in the inbox, ranked by relevance. The
query is matched against senders, recipients, and subject (substring)
and the message body (tokenized full text). Spam, trash, blocked, and
unauthenticated threads are always excluded. `limit` cannot exceed 100.

Full-text search across messages in the inbox, ranked by relevance. The
query is matched against the sender, recipients, and subject (substring)
and the message body (tokenized full text). Spam, trash, blocked, and
unauthenticated messages are always excluded. `limit` cannot exceed 100.

post.description:
Fetch metadata for up to 500 messages in one request. Missing or
restricted IDs are silently omitted; compare `count` against `limit`
to detect misses.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages batch-get --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-ids <id1> --message-ids <id2>
```

Apply one label change to up to 50 messages in a single request. The
same add_labels and remove_labels apply to every message id, and at
least one of them must be provided. The update is atomic: either all
resolved messages are updated or none are. Missing or restricted ids
are silently excluded; compare `count` against `limit` to detect
exclusions.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages batch-update --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-ids <id1> --message-ids <id2> --add-labels read --remove-labels unread
```

post.description:
Attach a browser enrollment intent to the inbox. Requires
`api_key_create`. Before submitting `transaction_jti`, independently
verify that the browser page's final origin is exactly
`https://auth.agentid.com`.

This endpoint is available to every organization using US production.
It is not available in EU production.

Select `inbox_id` from trusted AgentMail configuration. An AgentID
`login_hint` is not authoritative for selecting the inbox; when the
transaction includes one, it must match the path inbox.

**AgentMail API keys are sent only to `https://api.agentmail.to`; AgentID never requests them.**

A new intent returns `202`; an idempotent retry for the same pending
transaction, inbox, and bearer key returns `200` with the same receipt.
An intent lasts at most five minutes. An activated credential lasts at
most 30 days and cannot outlive its authorizing bearer API key.

Creation is limited to 20 intents per bearer API key per hour, 100 per
organization per hour, and five live unused intents per bearer API key.
Browser activation is separately limited to 20 activations per
authorizing bearer API key per UTC day. Either kind of limit can return
`429`; honor the `Retry-After` header. Cancelling an enrollment releases
its live-intent slot but does not reset the daily activation counter.

Counts of email events (sent, delivered, bounced, etc.) over time for
the inbox. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the
last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. Omit `period` for
individual event counts, or set it to sum counts into buckets of that
many seconds.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes metrics query-events --inbox-id <inbox_id>
```

Cumulative usage series for the inbox. Each point is the running total
of the usage type at that timestamp, not the change within the bucket.
Inbox-scoped queries carry `storage_bytes`, `message_count`, and
`thread_count`; requested types that don't apply to the scope are
ignored. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the
last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. The range divided
by `period` must not exceed 1000 buckets.

get.description: Build a one-click DNS setup link for the domain via the Domain Connect standard. When the domain's DNS provider supports Domain Connect and carries the AgentMail template, the response contains a signed URL: opening it lets the domain owner approve the required DNS records at their provider, which writes them automatically — no copy-paste. When the provider does not support it, `supported` is `false` and the domain's `records` should be added manually instead.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail lists list --direction <direction> --type <type>
```

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail lists get --direction <direction> --type <type> --entry <entry>
```

List only public-key credentials visible to the bearer caller's scope.
Bearer credentials are never returned, even though both credential types

post.description:
Register a public P-256 JWK using an existing AgentMail bearer API key
with `api_key_create`. Re-registering the same JWK creates a new
credential ID; it does not replace or recover an earlier credential.
The private key must never be sent to AgentMail.

patch.description:
Rename the credential. All security-relevant fields are immutable.
Requires `api_key_update`.

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

delete.description:
Permanently revoke one public-key credential. This hard-deletes the
credential; repeating the request returns not found. Requires
`api_key_delete`.

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

post.description:
Invalidate every current public-key credential in the caller's
organization by advancing its AgentID key generation. The caller must be
organization-scoped and either have `api_key_delete` or, for a verified
self-serve agent organization, use an unrestricted unmanaged bearer
credential. No request body is accepted.

`Idempotency-Key` is required and must be a UUID. Reusing the same UUID
returns the original permanent receipt without advancing the generation
again. A new UUID performs a new generation advance.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required UUID identifying this revoke-all operation permanently.

fern_type_messages_MessageReferences.title: MessageReferences

fern_type_messages_MessageUpdatedAt.description: Time at which message was last updated.
fern_type_messages_MessageUpdatedAt.title: MessageUpdatedAt

fern_type_messages_MessageCreatedAt.description: Time at which message was created.
fern_type_messages_MessageCreatedAt.title: MessageCreatedAt

reply_to.description: Reply-to addresses. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

expires_at.description: Time at which the download URL expires.

add_labels.description: Labels to add to thread. Cannot be system labels.

remove_labels.description: Labels to remove from thread. Cannot be system labels. Takes priority over `add_labels` (in the event of duplicate labels passed in).

from.description: Matched fragments from the sender address.

recipients.description: Matched fragments from the recipient addresses (to, cc, or bcc).

text.description: Matched fragments from the message body.

fern_type_messages_SearchMessageHighligh.description:
Matched fragments per field on a message search result, with matched terms
wrapped in `**`. A field key is present only when the query matched that
field, so the present keys also tell you which fields produced the hit.
fern_type_messages_SearchMessageHighligh.title: SearchMessageHighlights

highlights.description: Matched fragments per field. Present only when the query matched an indexed field.

messages.description: Ordered by relevance, best match first.

fern_type_messages_BatchGetMessagesMessa.description:
IDs of messages to fetch. Maximum 500 ids per request. Duplicates are
rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including
cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently omitted from the
response; callers detect misses by comparing `count` against `limit`.
fern_type_messages_BatchGetMessagesMessa.title: BatchGetMessagesMessageIds

messages.description:
Found messages. Order matches `message_ids` in the request. Body
fields (`text`, `html`, `extracted_text`, `extracted_html`) are
never populated; use the single-message endpoint to retrieve bodies.

fern_type_messages_BatchUpdateMessagesMe.description:
IDs of messages to update. Maximum 50 ids per request. Duplicates are
rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including
cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently excluded from the
update; callers detect exclusions by comparing `count` against `limit`.
fern_type_messages_BatchUpdateMessagesMe.title: BatchUpdateMessagesMessageIds

add_labels.description: Label or labels to add to every message.

remove_labels.description: Label or labels to remove from every message.

updates.description:
Updated messages with their new labels. Order matches `message_ids`
in the request. Excluded ids are omitted, so `count` may be less than
`limit`.

fern_type_api-keys_BrowserEnrollmentTran.description: Transaction identifier read from an enrollment action on exactly `https://auth.agentid.com`.
fern_type_api-keys_BrowserEnrollmentTran.title: BrowserEnrollmentTransactionJti

fern_type_api-keys_CreateBrowserEnrollme.description:
Attach a browser enrollment intent to one pending AgentID authorization
transaction. The inbox is selected by the trusted path parameter, not an
AgentID `login_hint`.
fern_type_api-keys_CreateBrowserEnrollme.title: CreateBrowserEnrollmentRequest

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp after which the pending enrollment cannot be activated.

fern_type_api-keys_BrowserEnrollmentAcce.description:
Pending enrollment receipt. The browser completes key creation and proof
on the existing AgentID page. This response contains no URL, token, or
navigation instruction.
fern_type_api-keys_BrowserEnrollmentAcce.title: BrowserEnrollmentAccepted

fern_type_events_EventTypes.description: Event types for which to send events.
fern_type_events_EventTypes.title: EventTypes

fern_type_events_PodIds.description: Pods for which to send events. Maximum 10 per webhook.
fern_type_events_PodIds.title: PodIds

fern_type_events_InboxIds.description: Inboxes for which to send events. Maximum 10 per webhook.
fern_type_events_InboxIds.title: InboxIds

updated_at.description: Time at which webhook was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which webhook was created.

header_names.description: Names of the custom delivery headers configured for this webhook. Header values are never returned.

fern_type_webhooks_CreateWebhookEventTyp.description:
Full list of event types this webhook should receive. At least one type is required. Send every type you
want in this array (not incremental). See [Webhooks overview](https://docs.agentmail.to/webhooks-overview)
for spam, blocked, and unauthenticated events and required permissions.
fern_type_webhooks_CreateWebhookEventTyp.title: CreateWebhookEventTypes

fern_type_webhooks_WebhookHeaders.description:
Custom HTTP headers to include with every delivery to this webhook. Header values are write-only:
AgentMail never returns them from webhook read endpoints. The map must contain at least one entry
when provided, and every name and value must be a valid HTTP header.
fern_type_webhooks_WebhookHeaders.title: WebhookHeaders

fern_type_webhooks_CreateInboxWebhookReq.description:
Create a webhook scoped to an inbox. The inbox comes from the path, so `inbox_ids` and `pod_ids`
are not accepted.
fern_type_webhooks_CreateInboxWebhookReq.title: CreateInboxWebhookRequest

fern_type_webhooks_UpdateWebhookEventTyp.description:
When you send a non-empty list, it replaces the webhook's subscribed event types in full (the same
"set the list" behavior as create). It is not a merge or diff: include every event type you want after
the update. Sending a one-element array means the webhook will only receive that one type afterward.
Omit this field or send an empty array to leave event types unchanged. Clearing all types with an empty
list is not supported. Subscribing to `message.received.spam`, `message.received.blocked`, or
`message.received.unauthenticated` requires the matching label permission on the API key.
fern_type_webhooks_UpdateWebhookEventTyp.title: UpdateWebhookEventTypes

fern_type_webhooks_UpdateInboxWebhookReq.description: Update an inbox-scoped webhook. It is fixed to its inbox, so only `event_types` can change.
fern_type_webhooks_UpdateInboxWebhookReq.title: UpdateInboxWebhookRequest

remove_headers.description: Names of custom delivery headers to remove.

fern_type_webhooks_UpdateWebhookHeadersR.description:
Set, replace, or remove custom delivery headers. Provide at least one of `headers` or
`remove_headers`. A header cannot be set and removed in the same request, regardless of casing.
fern_type_webhooks_UpdateWebhookHeadersR.title: UpdateWebhookHeadersRequest

fern_type_lists_EntryType.description: Whether the entry is an email address or domain.
fern_type_lists_EntryType.title: EntryType

entry.description: Email address or domain of list entry.

created_at.description: Time at which entry was created.

read_only.description: Whether the entry is read-only and cannot be deleted via the API.

inbox_id.description: ID of inbox, if entry is inbox-scoped.

entry.description: Email address or domain to add.

fern_type_metrics_MetricEventTypes.description: List of metric event types to query.
fern_type_metrics_MetricEventTypes.title: MetricEventTypes

fern_type_metrics_Period.description: Size of each time bucket as a whole number of seconds, between 1 and 86400.
fern_type_metrics_Period.title: Period

fern_type_metrics_MetricLimit.description: Limit on number of buckets to return.
fern_type_metrics_MetricLimit.title: MetricLimit

count.description: Count of events in the bucket.

fern_type_metrics_UsageType.description:
Type of usage metric. Inbox-scoped queries carry `storage_bytes`,
`message_count`, and `thread_count`; pod-scoped queries add `inbox_count`
and `domain_count`; organization-scoped queries add `pod_count`.
fern_type_metrics_UsageType.title: UsageType

fern_type_metrics_UsageTypes.description: List of usage metric types to query. Omit to query every type valid for the scope.
fern_type_metrics_UsageTypes.title: UsageTypes

value.description: Cumulative value of the usage metric at the timestamp.

fern_type_metrics_QueryUsageResponse.description: Cumulative usage series grouped by usage type.
fern_type_metrics_QueryUsageResponse.title: QueryUsageResponse

fern_type_inbox-events_InboxEventType.description:
Type of inbox event. Wire format is dot.case to match the
convention used by webhook events (`message.received`,
`domain.verified`, etc. in events.yml). Pre-2026-04 these were
`label_added`/`label_removed` (snake_case). The Fern enum's `name`
field stays uppercase-snake (Fern convention); only the wire
`value` changed.
fern_type_inbox-events_InboxEventType.title: InboxEventType

event_at.description: Time at which the event occurred.

created_at.description: Time at which the event was recorded.

message_read.description: Read messages. Also required to read threads.

message_update.description: Update message labels. Also required to update threads.

message_delete.description: Delete messages. Also required to delete threads.

fern_type_api-keys_ApiKeyPermissions.description: Granular permissions for the API key. When ommitted all permissions are granted. Otherwise, only permissions set to true are granted.
fern_type_api-keys_ApiKeyPermissions.title: ApiKeyPermissions

fern_type_api-keys_CreatedAt.description: Time at which api key was created.
fern_type_api-keys_CreatedAt.title: CreatedAt

pod_id.description: Pod ID the api key is scoped to. If set, the key can only access resources within this pod.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID the api key is scoped to. If set, the key can only access resources within this inbox.

used_at.description: Time at which api key was last used.

pod_id.description: Pod ID the api key is scoped to.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID the api key is scoped to.

fern_type_domains_FeedbackEnabled.description: Bounce and complaint notifications are sent to your inboxes.
fern_type_domains_FeedbackEnabled.title: FeedbackEnabled

fern_type_domains_SubdomainsEnabled.description:
Allow inboxes on any subdomain of this domain. Adds a required wildcard MX
record (`*.<domain>`) to `records`.
fern_type_domains_SubdomainsEnabled.title: SubdomainsEnabled

fern_type_domains_TrackingEnabled.description:
Serve open tracking pixels from this domain. Adds a required `link.<domain>`
CNAME record to `records`, which must be published and verified before
`track_opens` can be used on a send.
fern_type_domains_TrackingEnabled.title: TrackingEnabled

fern_type_domains_Status.description: The verification status of the domain.
fern_type_domains_Status.title: Status

type.description: The type of the DNS record.

name.description: The name or host of the record.

status.description: The verification status of this specific record.

priority.description: The priority of the MX record.

reason.description: Why the record is INVALID, when known. `duplicate_records` means the expected value is present but extra records coexist at the same name; `value_mismatch` means a record exists but does not match the expected value.

Why the domain is not (yet) VERIFIED, when known. `dns_records_missing` / `dns_records_invalid` point at the DNS records. The `ses_*` values mean the records look right and sending-infrastructure validation has not converged: `ses_dkim_pending` / `ses_mail_from_pending` (still checking), `ses_dkim_temporary_failure` / `ses_mail_from_temporary_failure` (a transient error the infrastructure keeps retrying on its own — usually resolves without changes), `ses_dkim_failed` / `ses_mail_from_failed` (a terminal verdict; re-verify after fixing), `ses_dkim_not_started` / `ses_mail_from_not_started` (the attribute was never configured on the identity — re-verify to push it), and `ses_not_verified_for_sending`. Absent when VERIFIED.

records.description:
A list of DNS records required to verify the domain. Includes a
wildcard MX record (`*.<domain>`) when `subdomains_enabled` is true.

updated_at.description: Time at which the domain was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which the domain was created.

fern_type_domains_UpdateDomainRequest.description:
Provide at least one of `feedback_enabled`, `subdomains_enabled`, or
`tracking_enabled`. Omitted
fields are left unchanged; an empty body is rejected. Enabling
`subdomains_enabled` on a verified domain returns it to `PENDING` until the
newly-required wildcard MX record (`*.<domain>`) is published and verified.
fern_type_domains_UpdateDomainRequest.title: UpdateDomainRequest

supported.description: Whether one-click setup is available for this domain. `false` means the domain's DNS provider does not support Domain Connect (or does not carry the AgentMail template yet) — add the domain's `records` manually instead.

provider_name.description: Display name of the domain's DNS provider, for the setup button label.

url.description: The signed Domain Connect apply URL. Open it in a browser: the domain owner signs in at their DNS provider, reviews the records, and approves — the provider writes them.

width.description: Suggested popup width from the provider, in pixels.

height.description: Suggested popup height from the provider, in pixels.

state.description: Opaque value echoed back on the provider's redirect. Store it before opening the URL and compare on return to tie the redirect to this request.

conflicting_provider.description: Set when the domain currently has another email provider's MX records (for example Google Workspace). Applying the template would replace them — warn before proceeding.

entry.description: Email address or domain of list entry.

created_at.description: Time at which entry was created.

read_only.description: Whether the entry is read-only and cannot be deleted via the API.

fern_type_api-keys_PublicJwkCoordinate.description: A 32-byte P-256 coordinate encoded as unpadded base64url.
fern_type_api-keys_PublicJwkCoordinate.title: PublicJwkCoordinate

fern_type_api-keys_PublicJwk.description:
A public P-256 JWK. The object accepts exactly `kty`, `crv`, `x`, and `y`.
Private key material such as `d`, embedded key IDs, and all other members
are rejected. The server also rejects coordinates that are not a point on
P-256.
fern_type_api-keys_PublicJwk.title: PublicJwk

fingerprint.description: RFC 7638 SHA-256 JWK thumbprint encoded as unpadded base64url.

fern_type_api-keys_PublicKeyMaterial.description: Registered public key material and its server-computed RFC 7638 thumbprint.
fern_type_api-keys_PublicKeyMaterial.title: PublicKeyMaterial

fern_type_api-keys_PublicKeyScope.description: The immutable scope in which a public-key credential can approve AgentID sign-in.
fern_type_api-keys_PublicKeyScope.title: PublicKeyScope

api_key_id.description: Server-generated credential ID. Store this value as the signing key's `kid`.

type.description: Server-owned credential discriminator. Callers cannot select or update it.

expires_at.description: Immutable absolute expiry. Omitted when the credential does not expire.

revoked_at.description: Present when organization-wide revoke-all invalidated this credential generation.

fern_type_api-keys_PublicKeyCredential.title: PublicKeyCredential

public_keys.description: Public-key credentials only, ordered by creation time descending by default.

name.description: Defaults to `AgentID key {first eight fingerprint characters}`.

scope.description:
Omit to inherit the registering bearer key's exact scope. An explicit
scope must be the caller's scope or a live descendant.

expires_at.description:
Future absolute expiry. Omit to inherit the registering bearer key's
expiry. A child credential cannot outlive its creator.

fern_type_api-keys_CreatePublicKeyReques.description:
Register only a public P-256 JWK. Credential type, `api_key_id`, sign-in
eligibility, permissions, and generation are server-owned and are not
request properties.
fern_type_api-keys_CreatePublicKeyReques.title: CreatePublicKeyRequest

fern_type_api-keys_UpdatePublicKeyNameRe.description:
Rename a public-key credential. Key material, ID, type, scope, sign-in
eligibility, permissions, generation, and expiry are immutable.
fern_type_api-keys_UpdatePublicKeyNameRe.title: UpdatePublicKeyNameRequest

fern_type_api-keys_RevokeAllAgentIdSignI.description: Permanent idempotency receipt for an organization-wide AgentID sign-in key revocation.
fern_type_api-keys_RevokeAllAgentIdSignI.title: RevokeAllAgentIdSignInKeysResponse

api_key_id.description: Bearer API key that authorized creation of the browser credential.

created_at.description: Incarnation timestamp of the authorizing bearer API key.

fern_type_api-keys_BrowserCredential.description: Owner-facing metadata for an active browser credential. Private key material never leaves the browser.
fern_type_api-keys_BrowserCredential.title: BrowserCredential

client_url.description: Registered client URL, when one is available.

approved_scopes.description: At least one non-empty scope approved for this client.

fern_type_api-keys_BrowserConsent.description: Remembered approval for one closed AgentID client and inbox.
fern_type_api-keys_BrowserConsent.title: BrowserConsent

updated_at.description: Time at which provider was last updated.

fern_type_providers_Provider.description: A provider an inbox can sign in to.
fern_type_providers_Provider.title: Provider

first_signed_in_at.description: Time of first sign-in at provider.

last_signed_in_at.description: Time of most recent sign-in at provider.

fern_type_accounts_Account.description: One inbox signed in at one provider.
fern_type_accounts_Account.title: Account

inbox_id.description: Inbox to connect. Required unless the API key is scoped to an inbox.

authorize.description: Authorize the provider for this inbox, skipping the first-use disclosure page.

magic_url.description: Single-use URL to open in the browser that will hold the sign-in.

expires_at.description: Time at which the URL expires.

fern_type_webhooks_CreatePodWebhookReque.description:
Create a webhook scoped to a pod. The pod comes from the path, so `pod_ids` is not accepted.
Optionally pass `inbox_ids` to narrow the webhook to specific inboxes within the pod; omit to
receive events for the whole pod.
fern_type_webhooks_CreatePodWebhookReque.title: CreatePodWebhookRequest

add_inbox_ids.description: Inbox IDs to subscribe to the webhook.

remove_inbox_ids.description: Inbox IDs to unsubscribe from the webhook.

fern_type_webhooks_UpdatePodWebhookReque.description:
Update a pod-scoped webhook. You can adjust which inboxes within the pod it listens to and replace
its `event_types`, but not the pod scope itself.
fern_type_webhooks_UpdatePodWebhookReque.title: UpdatePodWebhookRequest

fern_type_auth_ScopeType.description: The scope tier the authenticated credential is bound to.
fern_type_auth_ScopeType.title: ScopeType

scope_id.description:
ID of the most specific scope the credential is bound to.
Equals inbox_id when scope_type is inbox, pod_id when pod, organization_id when organization.

pod_id.description: ID of the pod the credential is scoped to. Present when scope_type is pod or inbox.

inbox_id.description: ID of the inbox the credential is scoped to. Present when scope_type is inbox.

api_key_id.description: ID of the API key used to authenticate. Absent for JWT and proxy credentials.

fern_type_auth_Identity.description: Identity and scope of the authenticated credential.
fern_type_auth_Identity.title: Identity
